rationale: Five blocking findings after reading the real code: a catalog-less setup loop with no exit, an unthreaded catalog isRouter hint, session-confirmed ids lost on coverage retry, a stdout warning in legacy launch, and a generic Error (standards). All four lenses and the standards audit ran. 1 deferred (setup.ts size overage, pre-existing; written to code-review-deferred.md), 17 dismissed as noise (verified loader passes new fields, heuristic limits, test-hygiene items, spec-mandated override skip).

findings.title: Legacy-profile mismatch warning writes to stdout
findings.problem: checkHarnessCompatibility prints the legacy-profile warning and the sibling/setup hint with console.log, then lets the launch continue. handleRun auto-enables silent mode for non-interactive, --task and ACP/SDK callers precisely because stdout is parsed, and the surrounding code (install error, Windows guidance) deliberately uses console.error for that reason. claude-acp, codex-acp and similar resolve to the base agent's classifier, so they reach this path.
findings.impact: A legacy profile whose active model does not match the launching harness injects non-protocol text into the stdout stream of ACP editors, SDKs and CI wrappers, which can break their parsing. Reachable on any legacy profile with a mismatching active model.
findings.recommendation: Write the warning and hint lines to stderr (console.error) or logger.warn instead of console.log in checkHarnessCompatibility; the harness-block path exits, so only the continuing legacy path matters.

findings.title: Confirmed model ids lost when coverage gate loops back
findings.problem: In handlePluginSetup the retry loop rebuilds harnessCtx from existingProfile?.confirmedModels only. Ids the user confirmed during this session live in the local confirmed set of promptForModelsSelection and in result.confirmedModels, but are never carried into the next iteration. A typed id is also not in the outer catalog list, so on retry it is not a choice and drops out of the pre-checked selection.
findings.impact: When the coverage gate fails for a second harness after the user confirmed an incompatible typed id, the id is silently dropped or must be retyped and reconfirmed. Spec requirement for catalog-less confirm handling is only partly met.
findings.recommendation: Accumulate confirmed ids across loop iterations (seed from existingProfile.confirmedModels, add result.confirmedModels each pass) and pass the union to buildHarnessContext; keep pre-selected typed ids that are not in the catalog as visible choices on retry.

findings.title: Post-install coverage gate throws generic Error
findings.problem: The new post-install check throws a bare Error ('No installed model works with ... profile not saved'). AGENTS.md Common Pitfalls require specific project error classes, and ConfigurationError exists in src/utils/errors.ts.
findings.impact: Breaks the documented error-handling convention in newly added code and leaves callers unable to distinguish this configuration failure from generic errors.
findings.recommendation: Throw ConfigurationError (src/utils/errors.ts) instead of Error at this site.

findings.title: Catalog-less setup loops forever on unsupported provider
findings.problem: The dead-end check in handlePluginSetup runs only when models.length > 0. With an empty catalog, promptForManualOrSearchModel loops until uncoveredHarness is empty, but classifyModelForAgent returns incompatible for a provider outside the agent's supportedProviders before it consults confirmedModels, so no typed or confirmed id can ever cover that harness. Example: kimi supports only moonshot-subscription and ai-run-sso, so kimi on litellm with a failed or empty model fetch never terminates.
findings.impact: Setup hangs re-asking 'Enter a model for <harness>' with no explanation and no change-agents or cancel option; only Ctrl-C leaves. Spec requires explaining the dead end and letting the user change provider or harness.
findings.recommendation: Before the manual-entry loop, run the dead-end check for any selected classifier harness whose supportedProviders excludes the provider (promptForHarnessDeadEnd: change agents or cancel), and give the loop an exit for an unsatisfiable uncovered harness.

findings.title: Catalog isRouter hint not threaded beyond models list
findings.problem: ModelInfo.metadata.isRouter is read only in `codemie models list`. The setup model filter (isVisible, harnessLabel, acceptTypedModel, uncoveredHarness), runModelsSwitch, ProfileDisplay and the launch check classify by name only. A catalog-flagged router or alias without 'router' in its id (e.g. sy-signal-terra-luna) is unverified in one view and incompatible in the others.
findings.impact: Such aliases are hidden from the setup picker, shown as [none] in switch and status, and, once a profile has harnesses, would hard-block launch with exit 1. Reachability of the launch block was confirmed from code (no catalog or router flag is available there). The spec's three-state rule and docs ('unverified' for routers/aliases) are only partly met.
findings.recommendation: Add an isRouter lookup built from catalog metadata to HarnessModelContext and pass it in the setup filter/label/accept/coverage calls and to harnessAnnotations in runModelsSwitch and ProfileDisplay; since launch has no catalog, persist ids accepted through the router hint (e.g. in confirmedModels) so checkHarnessCompatibility reports them unverified.
